title: Connectivity-Aware Client Selection in Decentralized Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.41570v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Decentralized federated learning (DFL) has emerged as a scalable alternative to centralized federated learning, removing the single point of failure and communication bottleneck at the server. However, most existing decentralized approaches rely on full-neighborhood broadcasting, where each client transmits its model update to all of its neighbors in each communication round. While effective, this results in significant communication overhead and high energy consumption. This paper applies spectral graph tools as lightweight client selection methods that leverage the graph topology by analyzing the spectral properties of the graph Laplacian over a fixed communication graph. Specifically, we exploit eigenvector embeddings and heat/diffusion kernel similarities to guide each client in selecting only a subset of structurally relevant neighbors, i.e., those that are most beneficial for the convergence of the federation process. translated_title: 去中心化联邦学习中的连接感知客户端选择
translated_abstract: 去中心化联邦学习（DFL）已成为中心化联邦学习的一种可扩展替代方案，消除了服务器端的单点故障和通信瓶颈。然而，大多数现有的去中心化方法依赖于全邻居广播，即每个客户端在每轮通信中将其模型更新传输给其所有邻居。这种方法虽然有效，但会导致巨大的通信开销和高能耗。本文将谱图工具作为轻量级的客户端选择方法，通过分析固定通信图上图拉普拉斯算子的谱特性来利用图拓扑结构。具体而言，我们利用特征向量嵌入以及热核/扩散核相似度来指导每个客户端仅选择结构上相关的邻居子集，即那些对联邦过程收敛最有益的邻居。这种拓扑感知的选择方式……（摘要不完整，原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出利用谱图工具（特征向量嵌入和热/扩散核相似度）分析固定通信图的拓扑结构，指导去中心化联邦学习中每个客户端仅选择对收敛最有益的邻居子集，从而在保证训练效果的同时显著降低通信开销与能耗。
